preparePulseSummaries.reason: Owned BeginPulseScheduleRead/LoadSchedule/LoadFeed retain their already-reviewed source/admission lifetime through processing. Only the bounded branch now uses CommitPulseSummaries for one atomic all-due-member cursor plus notification/delivery commit, with installed native feature/schedule/preferences/push rechecks and the unchanged defaultPreferences/category/delivery decisions. The original MutateWorkspace callback remains literal off mode. Strict native/canonical policy table covers absent, present-zero, nil/empty and disabled categories, operator defaults, digest/chat/push, feature/schedule changes, prior cursor and cursor-only recipients; actual preparePulseSummaries flag differential compares complete update references, canonical cursor, notification/delivery output and recipient/summary signals, including second-tick no-op. Writer Tier A rollback/retry/quota/cancel, warm/reloaded, large-cursor/1000-recipient/stale-peer, persistent SQLite twice and targeted race passed; focused invited-member, daily-to-weekly and per-visibility business regressions passed. Bounded, the member list (ListMembers) decorates application members from owned installation reads; the scheduler tick has no request owner, so the pass now binds its own metadata output owner (beginMetadataOutputReads) from the member list to its end. Before that, any workspace with an application member failed the whole once-a-minute pass with "bounded metadata coverage is incomplete" (load rig smoke). TestScaleColdWritersPulseSchedulerWithApplicationMembers compares two passes legacy vs warm vs SQL-reloaded with an active application member: results, cursor and settings rows, notification and delivery rows, events and publications, installed settings/userSettings equal to a reload.
